equal_cost.label: Equal error cost
equal_cost.interpretation: A false occupied and false unoccupied decision have equal assumed consequence.

comfort_focused.label: Comfort-focused
comfort_focused.interpretation: Missing genuine occupancy is assumed five times as costly as responding to an empty room.

energy_focused.label: Energy-focused
energy_focused.interpretation: Responding to an empty room is assumed five times as costly as temporarily missing occupancy.

selection_rule: For each cost scenario, minimize total assumed error cost per 1000 out-of-fold chronological validation rows. Break ties with higher F1, then the threshold closest to 0.5. Test 1 and Test 2 never influence threshold selection.
calibration_note: Calibration is diagnosed with equal-width reliability bins, Brier score, and expected calibration error. No recalibration is fitted because a leakage-safe nested calibration comparison is outside this phase.
